expires_today.title: Flat2VR Bundle
expires_today.description: Play VR games that never fall flat!
expires_today.long_description:
Lose yourself in new worlds! Explore an epic collection of reality-bending games by Flat2VR Studios and discover what’s possible with the power of VR. Play Roboquest VR, the lightning-fast roguelite FPS where firepower and speed are king, brave I AM YOUR BEAST VR, the thrilling adaptation of Strange Scaffold’s short-form covert revenge story, or get your adrenaline pumping in VRacer Hoverbike. Don’t wait another second, now’s the perfect time to try VR gaming! Plus, a portion of your purchase helps support Take This.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 10th, 2027.

expires_today.title: The EC Archives: Tales From the Crypt and Other Stories by Dark Horse & EC Comics
expires_today.description: Tales of terror from the EC Archives
expires_today.long_description: Kick off your Halloween celebrations with a bundle of vintage fun courtesy of Dark Horse and EC Comics! Straight from the EC Archives come classic horror comic series like Shock SuspenStories, Terror Illustrated, The Vault of Horror, and the spooky anthology that inspired the iconic HBO show Tales from the Crypt! Get a taste of some creepy classics with this multi-volume bundle of vintage thrills sure to get you into the Halloween spirit! Grab this entire library if you dare at the price of your choosing, and support the Freedom to Read Foundation with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Best-Sellers of Amigurumi by Meteoor Books
expires_today.long_description: Brighten every shelf, desk, and corner of your home with adorable amigurumi! This craft ebook bundle from Meteoor Books and Amigurumi.com brings you step-by-step patterns for the sweetest crochet creations from whimsical gnomes and magical creatures to endangered animals and forest friends. You'll even find full wardrobes of miniature outfits for four lovable animal friends.  This bundle includes 24 ebooks of amigurumi patterns suitable for beginner and intermediate crafters, so get them now at the price of your choice, and support your favorite charity with your purchase!

expires_today.title: DIY Halloween Displays and Holiday Gifts

expires_today.title: Map Making MEGA Bundle Last Chance
expires_today.description: Chart your own path to map making
expires_today.long_description:
Passionate about building maps to great game worlds? Say hello to the Map Making MEGA Bundle. Whether it's dungeons and floorplans, starships and solar systems or even entire worlds, this treasure trove of assets and apps has what you need for your cartography. Map your world and help Save the Children at the same time!

All Humble Bundle customers will get a link to a secret backer level when the Campaign Cartographer 4 Kickstarter is launched. Follow the campaign now!

expires_tomorrow.title: Maximum Entertainment Indie Hits
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
It always feels extra special when an independently created game gets the hype and popularity it deserves. To celebrate our favorite breakout indie hits we’ve collected them all in one bundle of endless fun! Wreak havoc as a furry neighborhood menace sporting a fluffy tail and a firearm in Squirrel with a Gun! Explore a vast, hand-drawn fantasy world packed with fierce boss battles in Afterimage! Unravel an emotional, bittersweet mystery through a fateful journey of growing up in Until Then! All of these and more are included in this bundle of indie favorites, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support Spaceship Earth with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 11th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: 15th Anniversary - Sci-Fi Exposure
expires_tomorrow.description: Sci-fi like you’ve never seen before
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Celebrate 15 years of Humble Bundle with this collection of our favorite sci-fi games! In this bundle you’ll explore far-flung futures, survive hostile alien planets, and sink your teeth into intergalactic battles that feel realer than real. There are many more worlds and visions of the future to explore in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choice and support Charity: water with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.description: Become the world’s greatest football star
expires_within_72h.long_description: When Japan’s national football team ranked low at the 2018 World Cup, they knew something needed to be done. Now, you can get all currently published digital volumes of Blue Lock in one bundle, including volumes of the main series up to #38, redemption code for #39 on kodansha.us, and seven volumes of prequel miniseries Episode Nagi by Kota Sannomiya, Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yusuke Nomura! expires_within_72h.title: Data Engineering Masterclass
expires_within_72h.description: A masterclass in data engineering advancement
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Build comprehensive skills in databases, data analytics, and AI-driven data modeling through hands-on learning. Master SQL and MySQL fundamentals, advanced queries, joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, indexing, and performance optimization. Explore Neo4j, Cypher, Graph Data Science, vector databases, and embeddings to develop AI applications using semantic search, knowledge graphs, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Learn data modeling, ETL processes, Power BI, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Copilot. Apply your knowledge through practical projects involving data cleaning, analysis, database design, and optimization. Build a professional GitHub portfolio while gaining job-ready skills for real-world data management and AI applications.
